name: application-date-range-picker
title: Date Range Picker
description: Dual-pane range selector combining preset shortcuts and a month calendar, driven by a typed presets/day-grid prop contract.
useWhen: Filtering analytics, reports, or logs by a start and end date instead of a single day.
Users benefit from common presets (Today, Last 7 days, Month to date) alongside manual day selection.
You need a reusable range primitive instead of pairing two independent single DatePickers.
avoidWhen: Only a single date is needed — use the simpler DatePicker component instead.
The range spans many months at once — a text-based start/end input pair may be faster than paging a calendar.
Screen space is too narrow for a dual-pane layout — stack presets above the calendar instead of beside it.
responsiveBehavior: The preset rail and calendar sit side by side above a certain width; stack the preset rail above the calendar on narrow viewports so both remain fully usable.
accessibility: The active preset uses aria-current='true' in addition to its filled background, not color alone.
The popover uses role='dialog' with an aria-label describing its purpose.
Range endpoints use aria-selected while in-between days remain unmarked, so screen readers can distinguish the boundary from the fill.

variants.title: Date Range Picker
variants.description: Trigger button opening a preset rail plus month calendar with range highlighting, a nights summary, and cancel/apply actions.
accessibility: Range start/end days are visually distinct (filled circle) from in-between days (flat fill), reinforced by aria-selected on the endpoints.

variants.title: Date Range Picker (Dark)
variants.description: Date range picker adapted for dark surfaces with the same preset rail, calendar, and action structure.
accessibility: Preset list text, calendar text, and range-fill colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
